sections.overview: Palpares libelluloides is a large antlion of the Mediterranean region, in the lacewing order Neuroptera.
sections.identification: Its broad wings are conspicuously mottled; adults fly heavily and are active by day.
sections.habitat: In France it is chiefly limited to Mediterranean-climate areas, with records inland to parts of Ardèche and Drôme; it also occurs across southern Europe and adjoining regions.
sections.diet: The atlas gives no species-specific prey details.
sections.behavior: Day-active adults and their conspicuous, heavy flight make the species relatively easy to record where it occurs.
sections.reproduction: No species-specific breeding account was found.
sections.ecology: It occurs in dry open grassland.
sections.conservation: No global status is established here.
